content.text: The implementation now passes exhaustive checks on 2,000 small cases and certificate checks on 400 larger random cases. A bounded-runner test with the maximum 1,024-window batch across both CPU models completed in about 14 seconds, with its certificates independently checked. Malformed-input tests and eight empty epochs also passed. I’m running the final sanity check now.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 public_check.py && python3 -B tmp/bounded_tests.py && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/submission')
paths=list(root.rglob('*'))
regular=[p for p in paths if p.is_file()]
assert len(paths)+1<=256
assert sum(p.stat().st_size for p in regular)<=8*1024*1024
assert all(not p.is_symlink() and (p.is_file() or p.is_dir()) for p in paths)
assert all(p.stat().st_nlink==1 for p in regular)
print('Submission:', len(paths)+1, 'entries,',sum(p.stat().st_size for p in regular),'regular-file bytes')
PY
